answer: Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the dawn is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the timber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
